name: Sugar Free D'lite Yummy Berry Cookies
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Sweeteners (Maltitol, Sucralose), Hydrogenated Oil (Palm and Palm Kernel Oil), Black Currant (7%), Oats (5%), Butter, Fructo Oligosaccharides (3%), Quinoa (2%), Milk Solids, Raising Agents (INS 500 (ii), INS 503 (iii)), Nature Identical Flavouring Substances (Blueberry, Vanilla), Emulsifiers (Soya Lecithin, INS 472), Iodised Salt, Antioxidant (INS 330)
